note: First matching available tool wins. Argument sketches are templates, never executed. Query-only rules conservatively skip member writes and common mutators; hints may replace only a step of a larger script.

rules.reason: For per-body SAT export, consider this tool: many parts and bodies in one call, preflighted paths, per-body read-back verification and per-body errors. It writes part coordinates; transforms or other formats still need a script.

For building many boxes, tubes and extruded profiles (new, join or cut) in one part, consider this tool: all items preflighted together, each checked after building, built items kept and next_index reported on failure. Revolve, loft, sweep, fillets and patterns still need their tools or a script.
For the assembly design-view creation step, consider this tool (Inventor 2027); choose exact occurrence paths and existing assets if needed. Other script steps may still be required.
For occurrence appearance overrides, consider this tool with a selector and asset or RGB. It does not replace material edits or appearance-library editing.
For the occurrence-state step, consider this tool; supply visible, grounded, suppressed or pose explicitly. Only visibility supports nested matches; other changes require top-level occurrences.
For saving a root and its dirty references, consider this tool; inspect dry_run before saving. It does not save unrelated open documents or replace revision/rename logic.
For the document save step, consider this tool; add path for Save As. It does not perform Save Copy As, reference rewriting, replacement or an entire revision workflow.
For the document-open step, consider this tool; set visible as needed. This does not replace subsequent edits or representation selection.
For occurrence inventory, range boxes and transforms, consider this read-only tool (millimeters). Keep custom calculations separately; choose a selector/document to match the script scope.
For reading occurrence appearance/material names, consider this read-only inventory tool; it does not expose or edit library asset internals.
For assembly interference analysis, consider this read-only tool; scope occurrence sets explicitly. It reports intersecting pairs and volumes in mm3.
For occurrence clearance checks, consider this read-only tool with explicit occurrence pairs/selectors and supported references; arbitrary geometric operands may still need a script.
For the direct-file-reference/missing-reference check, consider this read-only tool; select document if needed. It does not perform a full model-health audit.
For the active assembly constraint-health check, consider this read-only tool. Other model-health checks and non-active document scopes may still need separate calls.
For listing dirty open/loaded documents, consider this read-only tool. It does not save them or perform a full health audit.
